name: On
overview: The topic 'On' in Scripture refers primarily to two distinct subjects: the ancient capital of Lower Egypt and a leader among the Reubenites who opposed Moses. The city of On is notably connected to Joseph's life in Egypt, as his wife Asenath was the daughter of Potipherah, a priest or prince of On, highlighting the city's significance in the narrative of God's providence and Joseph's rise (Genesis 41:45; 46:20). In contrast, On the son of Peleth appears in Numbers 16:1 as one of the Reubenite leaders who participated in Korah's rebellion against Moses, illustrating a moment of challenge to divinely appointed leadership. Together, these references demonstrate how 'On' serves both as a geographical and personal identifier within God's unfolding plan in Scripture.
